task_completion.description: Brain MRI data is loaded into the Slicer scene.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 2D slice viewers (Red, Green, Yellow) and/or the 3D viewer show brain anatomy from the BraTS dataset.

task_completion.description: A Line markup object is created in the Markups module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Markups' module panel or the 'Subject Hierarchy' shows a Line node.
The text 'Biopsy_Trajectory' is visible in the Markups list or Subject Hierarchy tree.

task_completion.description: Two control points are placed representing the entry and target.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Markups control point table shows exactly 2 points, and a line segment is visible connecting them in the viewers.

task_completion.description: The trajectory connects a superior scalp entry point to the tumor target.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the slice viewers, one end of the line is at the skin surface (superior/top of head) and the other end is within the visible tumor mass.

task_completion.description: The scene is saved after the trajectory is planned.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save Scene' dialog is opened, or a 'Scene saved' message appears in the status bar/log.

integrity.description: The agent used the Slicer GUI to place markups rather than just executing background scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Markups toolbar or placing points directly in the slice viewers.

integrity.description: The agent actually opened the target coordinates file to find the target location.
integrity.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window is seen displaying the contents of /home/ga/Documents/SlicerData/BraTS/tumor_target.txt.

integrity.description: The trajectory was created during the session, not pre-loaded.
integrity.visual_evidence: Early screenshots show an empty Markups list, while later screenshots show the 'Biopsy_Trajectory' node.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The markup must be a 'Line' type named exactly 'Biopsy_Trajectory'. It must have exactly 2 control points. The trajectory length should be between 30mm and 120mm. The target point must be within 15mm of the coordinates specified in the tumor_target.txt file, and the entry point must be on the scalp superior to the tumor.
